subject: prd/impl-review
statement: If any field of the frozen assessment, evidence citations, complete semantic profile, demand identity or derivation-policy version, actual band, join policy, or selected review harness is missing, changed from its authoritative carrier, unknown, contains native dispatch data where forbidden, or disagrees with the selected-harness input, then the system shall refuse process construction before any pass invocation and name the boundary and every offending field
